H8526H.name: Talmai
H8526H.desc: King living at the time of United Monarchy
H8526H.brief: King of Geshur; father of David's wife Maacah
H8526H.short: Talmai was the king of Geshur and father of Maacah, one of David's wives and mother of Absalom.

H8526G.name: Talmai
H8526G.desc: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H8526G.brief: Anakim king of Hebron, defeated by Judah
H8526G.short: Talmai was one of the Anakim kings of Hebron defeated by Caleb and the men of Judah.

H8559H.name: Tamar
H8559H.desc: David's daughter living at the time of United Monarchy
H8559H.brief: David's daughter, raped by her half-brother Amnon
H8559H.short: Tamar was David's daughter who was raped by her half-brother Amnon, leading to tragic consequences.

H8559I.name: Tamar
H8559I.desc: Absalom's daughter living at the time of United Monarchy
H8559I.short: Tamar was the beautiful daughter of Absalom, named after his tragic sister.

H8559G.name: Tamar
H8559G.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8559G.brief: Judah's daughter-in-law who bore Perez and Zerah
H8559G.short: Tamar was Judah's daughter-in-law who, after being wronged by him, bore twin sons Perez and Zerah.

H8576.name: Tanhumeth
H8576.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8576.brief: Supporter of Gedaliah after Jerusalem's fall
H8576.short: Tanhumeth the Netophathite was one of the leaders who supported Gedaliah's governorship after Jerusalem's fall.

H8599A.name: Tappuah
H8599A.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8599A.brief: Son of Hebron from the tribe of Judah
H8599A.short: Tappuah was a son of Hebron, a descendant of Judah.

H8520.name: Telah
H8520.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H8520.brief: Son of Resheph from the tribe of Ephraim
H8520.short: Telah was a descendant of Ephraim, the son of Resheph and father of Tahan.

H8547.name: Temah
H8547.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H8547.brief: Ancestor of a family of temple servants
H8547.short: Temah was the ancestor of a family of temple servants who returned from the Babylonian exile.

H8555.name: Timna
H8555.desc: Woman living at the time of the Patriarchs
H8555.brief: Concubine of Eliphaz; mother of Amalek
H8555.short: Timna was a concubine of Eliphaz, son of Esau, and the mother of Amalek.

H8583.name: Toi
H8583.desc: King living at the time of United Monarchy
H8583.brief: King of Hamath who sent his son to David
H8583.short: Toi, also known as Tou, was the king of Hamath who sent his son Joram to congratulate David on his victory over Hadadezer.

H8577B.name: Dragon Spring
H8577B.brief: A water source near Jerusalem, mentioned in Nehemiah's wall inspection.
H8577B.short: The Dragon Spring was a water source near Jerusalem, mentioned during Nehemiah's inspection of the city walls (<ref="Nehemiah 2:13">Nehemiah 2:13</ref>).

H8590.name: Taanach
H8590.brief: Canaanite city allotted to Manasseh, later a Levitical city
H8590.short: Taanach, a Canaanite city allotted to the tribe of Manasseh, later designated as a Levitical city (<ref="Josh. 12:21; 17:11; 21:25">Josh. 12:21; 17:11; 21:25</ref>).

H8559J.name: Tamar
H8559J.brief: Landmark on the southeastern border of Israel
H8559J.short: Tamar, a place mentioned as a landmark on the southeastern border of the Promised Land (<ref="Ezek. 47:18-19; 48:28">Ezek. 47:18-19; 48:28</ref>).

H8599B.name: Tappuah
H8599B.brief: Canaanite city allotted to Ephraim and Manasseh
H8599B.short: Tappuah (or En-tappuah), a Canaanite city on the border between Ephraim and Manasseh, allotted to Manasseh but with land belonging to Ephraim (<ref="Josh. 16:8; 17:7-8">Josh. 16:8; 17:7-8</ref>).

H8599G.name: Tappuah
H8599G.short: Tappuah, a town in the Shephelah (lowlands) of Judah (<ref="Josh. 15:34">Josh. 15:34</ref>).

H8512.name: Tel-abib
H8512.brief: Settlement of exiled Jews in Babylonia
H8512.short: Tel-abib, a settlement of exiled Jews by the Chebar River in Babylonia, where the prophet Ezekiel lived (<ref="Ezek. 3:15">Ezek. 3:15</ref>).

H8515.name: Telassar
H8515.brief: Mesopotamian city conquered by the Assyrians
H8515.short: Telassar, a Mesopotamian city conquered by the Assyrians, mentioned in the context of Sennacherib's boasting (<ref="2Kgs. 19:12; Isa. 37:12">2Kgs. 19:12; Isa. 37:12</ref>).

H8521.name: Tel-harsha
H8521.brief: Babylonian city from which exiles returned
H8521.short: Tel-harsha, a Babylonian city from which some Jewish exiles returned to Jerusalem, but could not prove their genealogy (<ref="Ezra 2:59; Neh. 7:61">Ezra 2:59; Neh. 7:61</ref>).

H8528.name: Tel-melah
H8528.brief: Babylonian city from which exiles returned
H8528.short: Tel-melah, a Babylonian city from which some Jewish exiles returned to Jerusalem, but could not prove their genealogy (<ref="Ezra 2:59; Neh. 7:61">Ezra 2:59; Neh. 7:61</ref>).

H8553G.name: Timnah
H8553G.brief: Canaanite city associated with Judah and Dan
H8553G.short: Timnah, a Canaanite city on the border between Judah and Dan, associated with Judah's son Er and Samson (<ref="Gen. 38:12-14; Josh. 15:10; 19:43; Judg. 14:1-5">Gen. 38:12-14; Josh. 15:10; 19:43; Judg. 14:1-5</ref>).

H8553H.name: Timnah
H8553H.brief: Town in the hill country of Judah
H8553H.short: Timnah, a town in the hill country of Judah (<ref="Josh. 15:57">Josh. 15:57</ref>).

H8556A.name: Timnath-heres
H8556A.brief: Town allotted to Joshua, where he was buried
H8556A.short: Timnath-heres (or Timnath-serah), a town in the hill country of Ephraim, allotted to Joshua, where he was buried (<ref="Josh. 19:50; 24:30; Judg. 2:9">Josh. 19:50; 24:30; Judg. 2:9</ref>).

H8507.name: Tochen
H8507.brief: Town in the territory of Simeon
H8507.short: Tochen, a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon (<ref="1Chr. 4:32">1Chr. 4:32</ref>).

H8542.name: Tammuz
H8542.brief: A Mesopotamian deity mourned by women in Jerusalem
H8542.short: Tammuz, a Mesopotamian deity, was mourned by women at the north gate of the Jerusalem temple, a practice condemned by Ezekiel (<ref="Ezk.8.14">Ezk.8.14</ref>).

H8550.name: Thummim
H8550.brief: Objects used with the Urim for divine guidance
H8550.short: The Thummim, along with the Urim, were objects carried in the breastpiece of the high priest's ephod and used to seek divine guidance (<ref="Exodus 28:30; Numbers 27:21">Exodus 28:30; Numbers 27:21</ref>).
